guidance_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
guidance_decisions.reason: Only tests for an established Fetch contract are added; no exported API, supported contract, or compatibility behavior is created or changed.

guidance_decisions.name: go-core-style
guidance_decisions.reason: Writing Go tests; applied standard-library fixtures, private state, clear failure checks, gofmt, vet, and race verification.

guidance_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
guidance_decisions.reason: Production dependency wiring, constructors, interfaces, and response ownership stay unchanged. Test fixture ownership and composition are covered by the selected isolation guidance.

guidance_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
guidance_decisions.reason: No package creation, relocation, responsibility change, or production import-direction change.

guidance_decisions.name: go-test-isolation
guidance_decisions.reason: The tests use HTTP transport/body doubles, local server fixtures, cancellation workers, channels, timers, resource lifetimes, and parallel subtests.

reference_relevance: Read for Go 1.22 event synchronization, fixture ownership, early-failure cleanup, HTTP boundary fidelity, and individually selectable parallel cases.
